profile_interpretation: DSP-adjacent synthetic evidence under the Room profile; no measured room acoustics or real-device claim

public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side as_register_provider_v0 only; no installed registry entry
public_boundary.sidechain: task-local nlms_aec_feed_reference helper only; not an SDK API/ABI change

reference.gain_before_feedback: synthetic L1 residual-path loop-margin proxy, not measured loudspeaker loop gain

canonical_report.format: canonical JSON: sort_keys=True, compact separators, allow_nan=False, one trailing newline

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. Installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The C provider is task-local and off by default. OFF leaves it unlinked and unregistered; ON requires explicit caller-side registration.
The render reference is explicit. With no supplied reference the provider and adapter pass the microphone through without adapting and report a blocked result.

Single-talk convergence, double-talk preservation, delay change/reconvergence, misalignment, delayed render, reference dropout and no-reference cases are all reported; no missing result qualifies a candidate.
ERLE/echo-return loss, near-end SNR, synthetic L1 gain-before-feedback proxy and fixed-attenuation controls are reported separately; fixed attenuation is never folded into adaptive-reference metrics.
Impulse, step, silence and clean-speech-like stimuli, numerical bounds, state reset, staleness rejection and adverse controls are explicit.

All evidence is deterministic synthetic data. No measured room acoustics, real recording, model weights, downloads, licensed runtime, listening, MOS/STOI on real speech, target-device timing or release qualification is claimed.
Canonical reports and synthetic output digests are byte-identically reproducible from pinned sources.
release_gates: Paired recorded far-end/microphone evidence with known render latency, pinned RIRs/path measurements and held-out real speech rights
Double-talk, path-change and nonlinear-loudspeaker assessment with AECMOS/ASR/listening and preservation gates
Measured loudspeaker-loop gain-before-feedback and stability with device buffers, clock drift and target-device CPU/memory/deadline timing
Provider intake, license/rights, descriptor and public catalog review before any default or installed provider
